deviations.description: Mandible rule fires too early: when mandible is forced into the PTV and cov is slightly below mand_lim (within about 2 Gy), with no other rule triggered, the network escalates although the protocol requires planning. Caused by the oversized bias of layer-1 unit 4 (cov - mand_lim detector).
deviations.condition: (mand_in_ptv - 0.05*ptv_vol > 0.1) and (cov <= mand_lim - 0.3) and (cov > mand_lim - 2.0) and (cov <= cap) and (cord_lim >= cord_floor) and (missing == 0)
